clinicalReviewMethod: Read all shared clinical evidence and nursing decisions; structurally verify each generated key and each of its four explanations against the evidence. Review semantic-similarity candidates by clinical cues and nursing decision, rather than matching text alone. Check cited educational and primary clinical references. This is an editorial/source review, not independent clinician approval.

replacementSimilarityDecisions.decision: Retain: intraamniotic infection during labor requires maternal-fetal management; postpartum uterine infection has a different clinical stage and no ongoing intrapartum fetal assessment.
Retain: suspected uterine rupture and intraamniotic infection have different findings and cause-specific emergency management.
